name: set_selected_object_proximity_radius_mode_1

stack.evidence: func_001D39B8 converts the top value to float, passes it to func_00123350 for the selected object with mode 1, and decrements Script stackTop by one

notes: func_00123350 stores radius at offset 0x44 of the selected object's runtime descriptor and stores mode 1 at offset 0x5F. func_0012CBD8 reads the same radius and mode when testing another object's horizontal distance, vertical separation, and facing relationship. This is the mode-1 counterpart of command 199 set_selected_object_proximity_radius_mode_2 and command 625 set_selected_object_proximity_radius, which selects mode 3. The JP corpus contains two calls.
